product_metadata.title: Space Heater, 1s Fast Heating Electric Heaters for Indoor Use with 3 Settings, Wide Oscillating Ceramic PTC Personal Heater, Aikoper Portable Room Small Heater with Overheat & Tip-over Protection
features: ⍟ 2 IN 1 PORTABLE HEATER AND FAN: Hug yourself and your loved ones with instant warmness, or refreshing air, with this space heater with fan. Make use of 3 heat settings and a fan-only setting so to customize your heating/cooling needs. In winter, the desk heater disperses evenly enjoyable heat, while in the summer it provides pleasant cooling that invigorates. Get this room heater fan with cooling and keep yourself comfortable no matter the weather season.

⍟ FAST & QUIET HEATING WITH 1 PRESS: Utilizing the power of an advanced ceramic PTC heating element the oscillating space heater delivers heating in a few seconds. But that doesn’t mean we sacrificed on the noise as the portable electric heater works silently (just 40db). Meaning you will stay focused on your activities or leisure. Add this space heater for indoor use anywhere in your home or office to eliminate chills, be at your best self and save you overall heating costs in chilly winter.

⍟ FOR WIDER & MORE EFFECTIVE HEATING/COOLING: This space heater outputs a wide-area current of heat. This wide and even heat quickly envelops you in comfortable warmth. Say NO to the little and weak space heater designs, and say YES to the effective and powerful indoor space heaters!

⍟ 100% SAFE HEATING AND COOLING: This oscillating portable heater comes equipped with an advanced safety system that includes 1. OVERHEAT PROTECTION SENSOR (prevents the portable oscillating ceramic heater with thermostat from getting too hot); 2. COOL-TOUCH HOUSING (stays cool even after hours of operation); 3. space heater TIP OVER PROTECTION SWITCH (cuts the power if your personal heater is accidentally knocked over). Safety was #1 priority in this award-winning heater design!
